name: javis
description: Search and read your Javis voice transcripts, summaries and personal wiki from ChatGPT and Codex.

interface.longDescription:
Javis, made by DeepShare AI, records and transcribes the conversations you capture with the HiJavis iOS app. It writes summaries of them and builds a personal wiki from them. This plugin lets ChatGPT search and read that material while you chat: list your recorded sessions, read transcripts and summaries, search across them, and browse your wiki. It can also add sessions to your wiki and help you review the Gmail threads Javis shortlisted for you.

Intended for people who already use HiJavis. You sign in with your Javis account, and the plugin only reaches your own Javis data. A new account with no recorded sessions returns empty results. The Gmail tools act only on threads Javis has shortlisted, which requires Gmail to be linked and Gmail suggestions to be switched on in the HiJavis app. The plugin cannot delete transcripts or send email.
